disease_label_per_paper: NLRP3-associated cryopyrinopathy with severe early-onset multisystem inflammation
presentation_summary: 4-year-old boy with recurrent infections, persistent diarrhea, periodic fever, failure to thrive, urticarial evanescent rashes, poor appetite, and right knee swelling with difficulty weight-bearing.

During the neonatal period he had recurrent systemic sterile inflammation without an identifiable infectious trigger; immunodeficiency had been considered because of delayed umbilical cord separation and exuberant neutrophilic leukocytosis.
Exam showed irritability, frontal bossing, open anterior fontanelle, bony swelling of the right knee, and inability to bear weight.
Multidisciplinary evaluation found papilledema and moderate sensorineural hearing loss without cerebral atrophy.
Pretreatment table reported weight 9 kg, hemoglobin 4 g/dL, TLC 19,920/uL, platelets 508,000/uL, ESR 140 mm/hr, CRP 107 mg/dL, and papilledema.
NLRP3 p.Met662Thr pathogenic variant and dramatic recovery on anakinra are preserved as confirmatory/non-ranking context; persistence of hearing loss and knee swelling is outcome context.
